problem: The P3 promotion gate loads only the original P2 packet set. Later saturation rounds can supersede or basis-expand those packets, so a structurally valid but scientifically stale packet could otherwise remain eligible for future promotion.
hypothesis: A separate active-packet registry can resolve packet identity, supersession, basis-expanded-before-execution status and dependency blocking without rewriting any frozen packet or weakening the existing evidence/telemetry/applicability gates.
hard_rules: superseded packets never authorize new implementation or promotion
basis-expanded-before-execution packets are ineligible until a fresh replacement packet is frozen
blocked dependencies remain ineligible even if their own packet is structurally valid
packet registry status grants no scientific or promotion authority
historical legacy candidate verdicts remain unchanged
valid ACTIVE status only makes the ordinary promotion gate eligible to evaluate evidence
negative_controls: old vtg_lean_geometry_v1 remains structurally valid but must resolve SUPERSEDED
vtg_lean_geometry_v2 is structurally valid but must resolve BLOCKED_BASIS_EXPANDED after round 002
capstone_integrated_solver_v1 must resolve BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY while value-of-computation constituent is basis-expanded
rollback: Revert the registry/gate adapter. Frozen packet and saturation artifacts remain unchanged and continue to fail closed under the older P3 gate.
